title: 第15章 凶悍的乌环第16章 计划赶不上变化
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 唐二小胖子看了看孟虎魁梧的身板和凝气圆满的气息，又看了看柳如媚，挠挠头；
“孟师兄说得……也有点道理。
速战速决。”
白小巧则坚定地站在柳如媚一边：“师姐说得对，知己知彼，稳妥为上。”
众人目光最终落在姚德龙身上。
姚德龙咳嗽了两声，声音沙哑；
“老朽……咳咳……腿脚不便，稳妥些好。”
没用的老东西！”
孟虎低声骂了一句，脸色更黑。
最终，柳如媚拍板：先侦查。
众人隐匿身形，悄然潜行至秃鹫谷外围。
伏在山崖上向下望去，峡谷深处果然依着山壁搭建了一个简陋的木头山寨，
外围有岗哨巡逻。
他们耐着性子，从下午观察到傍晚，将山寨的布局和岗哨轮换规律摸了个大概。
期间，一个身材魁梧、满脸横肉、手持厚背开山刀的大汉走出主寨巡视，
其身上散发的灵力波动正是凝气八层！
正是匪首孙霸刀！
山寨内其他马匪，气息大多在凝气四层到六层之间，不足为惧。
“果然只是凝气八层！
孟虎眼中杀意更盛，早已按捺不住，
“柳师妹，还等什么？趁夜杀进去，一锅端了！”
柳如媚看着山寨布局，又看了看天色，终于点头；
寅时三刻（凌晨三点四十五），守卫最疲乏松懈时动手！
我与孟师兄主攻正面，唐师弟、白师妹负责清理两侧岗哨和支援。
姚师叔……”
她目光转向姚德龙，“您经验老道，烦请在外围掠阵，若有漏网之鱼，拦截即可。”
姚德龙默默点头。
孟虎则嗤之以鼻，显然认为姚德龙连掠阵都不配。
夜深人静，除了微微的虫鸣便无其他声音了！
寅时三刻，行动开始！
柳如媚与孟虎如同两道鬼魅，悄无声息地解决了门口两个打瞌睡的岗哨，率先杀入山寨！
唐二和白小巧紧随其后，扑向两侧的岗哨和小屋。
剑光闪烁，火焰升腾！
惨叫声瞬间划破寂静的夜空！
战斗一开始极为顺利。
content_en:
The little fat man Tang Er looked at Meng Hu's burly body and perfect Qi aura, then looked at Liu Rumei and scratched his head;
"What Senior Brother Meng said...makes sense.
Quick victory. "
Bai Xiaoqiao stood firmly on Liu Rumei's side: "Senior sister is right, know yourself and your enemy, and safety is the best."
Everyone's eyes finally fell on Yao Delong.
Yao Delong coughed twice, his voice hoarse;
"Old man...ahem...my legs and feet are inconvenient, so it's better to be safe."
"Hmph!
Useless old thing! "
Meng Hu cursed in a low voice and his face turned darker.
In the end, Liu Rumei made the decision: investigate first.
Everyone hid their bodies and quietly sneaked to the outskirts of the Vulture Valley.
Lying on the cliff and looking down, I saw that a simple wooden cottage was built against the mountain wall deep in the canyon.
There are sentries patrolling the perimeter.
They patiently observed from afternoon to evening, and got a rough idea of ​​the layout of the village and the rotation of sentry posts.
During this period, a burly man with a sinewy face and a thick-backed machete walked out of the main village to inspect.
The spiritual power fluctuations emanating from his body are the eighth level of Qi Condensation!
It's none other than the bandit leader Sun Ba Dao!
Most of the other horse bandits in the village have auras between the fourth and sixth levels of Qi Condensation, so there is nothing to fear.
“Sure enough, it’s only the eighth level of Qi Condensation!
Meng Hu's eyes became more murderous and he could no longer hold back.
"Junior Sister Liu, what are you waiting for? Go in at night and get a pot of it! "
Liu Rumei looked at the layout of the village, then looked at the sky, and finally nodded;
"Okay!
At three quarters of the Yin hour (three forty-five in the morning), the guards take action when they are most tired and lax!
Senior Brother Meng and I mainly attack the front, while Junior Brother Tang and Junior Sister Bai are responsible for clearing the sentries on both sides and providing support.
Uncle Yao..."
She turned to Yao Delong and said, "You are experienced, please scan the formation on the outside. If there is any fish that slips through the net, just intercept it. "
Yao Delong nodded silently.
Meng Hu sneered, obviously thinking that Yao Delong was not worthy of even raiding the formation.
In the dead of night, there is no other sound except the slight chirping of insects!
At three o'clock in the morning, the action begins!
Like two ghosts, Liu Rumei and Meng Hu quietly eliminated the two dozing sentries at the door and took the lead in entering the village!
Tang Er and Bai Xiaoqiao followed closely, rushing towards the sentries and huts on both sides.
The sword light flashes and the flames rise!
The screams instantly cut through the silent night sky!
The battle started off extremely smoothly.
